description: Architectural DXF reverse engineering: 3D concrete frame
message: Use this architectural DXF to build a 2-story 3D reinforced concrete frame calculation model and run analysis, filtering out non-structural building elements. Use 3.6 m story height for both stories and fixed column bases; apply floor area loads of 12 kN/m² on the first story and 10 kN/m² on the second story.
engineeringSpecification: Material C30: E=30000 MPa, ν=0.2, density=2500 kg/m3, and fc=14.3 MPa. Columns use C30 500x500 sections (H=500 mm, B=500 mm; A=0.25 m2, Iy=0.0052 m4, Iz=0.0052 m4, J=0.0088021 m4, G=12500 MPa). Beams use C30 300x600 sections (H=600 mm, B=300 mm; A=0.18 m2, Iy=0.0054 m4, Iz=0.00135 m4, J=0.00370786 m4, G=12500 MPa). Use SI units and the global-Z-up coordinate convention. Use only the declared floor loads and do not add member self-weight. Analysis combination: ULS = 1 × D.
